title: Receivables Aging & Collections
note: Computed by checks_dashboards_demo.py from the frozen .psv rows, with the same definitions truths.out uses. Each value carries the SQL it came from; Phase B2 holds every widget to these numbers.

kpis.label: Overdue 90+ days
kpis.sql: SELECT round(coalesce(sum(i.amount + i.tax_amount), 0), 2) FROM dash_demo.invoices i WHERE i.status IN ('open', 'overdue', 'partially_paid') AND i.amount + i.tax_amount >= 0 AND i.due_date < DATE '2026-09-30' - INTERVAL 90 DAY

kpis.label: Current, not overdue %
kpis.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN i.due_date >= DATE '2026-09-30' THEN i.amount + i.tax_amount ELSE 0 END) / sum(i.amount + i.tax_amount), 2) FROM dash_demo.invoices i WHERE i.status IN ('open', 'overdue', 'partially_paid') AND i.amount + i.tax_amount >= 0

kpis.label: DSO, days
kpis.sql: SELECT 365.0 * (SELECT sum(amount + tax_amount) FROM dash_demo.invoices WHERE issue_date <= DATE '2026-09-30' AND (last_paid_date IS NULL OR last_paid_date > DATE '2026-09-30')) / (SELECT sum(amount + tax_amount) FROM dash_demo.invoices WHERE issue_date > DATE '2026-09-30' - INTERVAL 365 DAY AND issue_date <= DATE '2026-09-30')

kpis.label: Customers overdue
kpis.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT i.customer_id) FROM dash_demo.invoices i WHERE i.status IN ('open', 'overdue', 'partially_paid') AND i.amount + i.tax_amount >= 0 AND i.due_date < DATE '2026-09-30'

kpis.label: Overdue invoices listed
kpis.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.invoices i WHERE i.status IN ('open', 'overdue', 'partially_paid') AND i.amount + i.tax_amount >= 0 AND i.due_date < DATE '2026-09-30'
